verdict.rationale: OpenAI documents a public REST API (OpenAPI spec, Responses API with code samples, RBAC for API-scoped permissions) and Codex CLI explicitly supports being driven with an API key, plus an MCP server interface for programmatic control. However, this MCP server is explicitly marked deprecated in favor of an undocumented 'app server', API key setup is called out as requiring 'additional setup', and community evidence states the latest gpt-5.3-codex model 'isn't available on the API yet' ('We are working to safely enable API access soon'), showing real gaps between the documented API and actual agent capability access. Missing for 10: a stable, non-deprecated first-party API/SDK specifically for driving the Codex agent (not just the general OpenAI Responses API), and confirmation that current-generation Codex models are fully API-accessible.
